scope: Development and offline threshold selection for cheap FLUX cache-risk features. This artifact does not qualify a serving controller.

evidence_roles.development: Failure-enriched data may select a feature group, fit coefficients, and select candidate thresholds, but may not make a confirmation or serving claim.
evidence_roles.confirmation: An untouched, prospectively registered, positive-containing holdout may confirm frozen scores and thresholds without refitting.
evidence_roles.intervention: A separate prospective run must execute the frozen controller and pass paired semantic-quality and measured-speed contracts before serving publication.

contract.failure_definition: Fail when either baseline-minus-candidate metric harm is strictly greater than its frozen limit.

profile_selection.candidate_unit: One immutable adaptive-candidate JSON. Anchor intervals, warmup/cooldown, predictor, tighten_error, recovery_error, acceleration_error, and allow_acceleration are selected as one atomic profile; controller thresholds may not be retuned after labels are opened.
profile_selection.candidate_grid: Freeze every candidate file hash and the prompt/seed matrix before collection.
profile_selection.quality_eligibility: The one-sided exact-binomial 95% prompt-group failure-rate upper bound must be no greater than 10% under the frozen two-metric contract.
profile_selection.ranking: Among quality-eligible profiles, choose the largest measured hardware speedup; break exact ties by candidate_id.
profile_selection.confirmation: Freeze the selected candidate file hash, then evaluate it once on a new registered profile holdout before any serving claim.
profile_selection.current_study_replay: The stage-gate study can reproduce the conservative brake-only choice, but it predates methodology-v1 and includes one frozen audit that was not contract-allowlisted. Its selection is legacy evidence, not a methodology-v1 serving qualification.

features.availability: Every feature must be computable during the cache request without a shadow/full-DiT teacher at skipped steps.

model.standardization: Fit StandardScaler inside each training fold.
model.validation: Leave one prompt_index out. All seeds and candidate strengths for one prompt remain in the same fold.
model.selection: Choose maximum grouped-OOF average precision; break ties in favor of fewer features.
model.threshold_source: Only target-policy grouped-OOF probabilities; never in-sample probabilities from the final all-data fit.

development.on_failure: Reject the feature family and do not spend a new confirmation holdout.

brake_threshold.interpretation: The development brake threshold is the highest inclusive cutoff that retains every observed target-policy failure.

oil_threshold.interpretation: Choose the largest low-risk cutoff whose development all-clear zone has zero observed failing prompt groups and a one-sided exact-binomial 95% prompt-group failure-rate upper bound no greater than 10%. Seeds from the same prompt never increase the independent-unit count. Twenty-nine zero-failure prompt groups are the minimum for that bound.

required_next_stages: Prospectively registered threshold confirmation with frozen features, coefficients, and thresholds and no refitting.
Prospective interventional A/B that actually executes brake/oil actions and remeasures paired ImageReward, VQAScore, and speed.

current_study_note: The 2026-08-03 failure-enriched study froze its stopping rules before collection but predates this methodology artifact. It may be replayed to validate a rejection; it may not export a positive frozen gate because the methodology hash was not preregistered.
